scientific_claim: Under the frozen d=6 cubic S3 feature construction and the prospectively fixed Branch38 finite-panel regime, all four construction panels retain exact rank 83 and exhibit a numerically resolved nonzero six-dimensional weak singular tail whose 320-dps weak right-singular subspace satisfies the precommitted cross-panel principal-angle stability criterion. This establishes reproducible finite-panel ill-conditioning, not a reduced algebraic S3 dimension.
